title: The headless lane runner serves only the proof harness (S24)
body:
Source: Fable architecture decision 2026-11-15, docs/program/plan.md S24 (Sector 6 — Harness and delivery (ADR 0022)); program t-b160jt0.
Why: ADR 0022 — moves the north-star items named in the plan sector. Counts toward the slop cut t-jgent6a.
Outcome: lane start is claim plus native worktree isolation; lane-run's worktree, preflight and git code, lane-canary and lane-lock are deleted; the session driver moves under evals/replay
Files: see ADR 0022 Consequences.
Proof: `node evals/replay/run.ts --arms C --units 1: verdict line`
Predicted: outside drain == 0 in >= 3 rows
After: S6, S22
